title: Bracket access with a string key on a closed object type fails at check time
notes: dsc 0.8.0 (dsc#88, bug 3) made a non-numeric index a check-time error and indexing a non-collection a check-time error, so obj["b"] is rejected before the isolate runs. The failure this fixture pins -- missing-key bracket access must not silently succeed -- still happens; it happens earlier, and it is now rejected at compile time instead of returning undefined and blowing up on `.length`. The remaining half (numeric bracket access still types as T instead of Option<T>) is dsc#98.
